name: macspeak
description: Reads a 1-3 sentence summary of each finished Claude Code reply aloud with the computer's built-in voice (macOS say or Windows SAPI), one voice at a time across sessions

voice.title: Mac voice
voice.description: A voice name from /speak voices (Mac e.g. Karen, Windows e.g. Microsoft Zira Desktop). Empty uses the system voice. /speak voice <name> overrides it.

rate.title: Speaking rate
rate.description: Words per minute (about 175-220 is natural). Empty uses the system rate. /speak rate <n> overrides it.

summaryModel.title: Summary model
summaryModel.description: Small fast model that turns a long reply into 1-3 spoken sentences
